row: Hello! Welcome to Catalyst Vet where we bring knowledge to you so that your pet can get the best care possible. The information provided here is not medical advice. Its purpose is to present diseases, diagnostic testing, and treatments in a way that helps to build a better and more cooperative relationship with your veterinarian when it comes to successful treatment of your pet. Catalyst vet and its associates are not responsible for the outcome of patient care or health. Every case is different, and medical decisions are only to be made between you and the veterinarian in charge of your pet’s care. Feel free to ask general questions in the comments!
